description: How integrated enterprise systems run a business on one shared database: the purpose of ERP, finance and accounting, procurement, inventory and supply chain, sales, human resources and payroll, the master and transaction data models underneath, and how ERP is selected, implemented and adapted for small and medium enterprises. Students run complete order-to-cash, procure-to-pay and hire-to-retire cycles on a simulated company in the browser and trace every document to its journal entries and tables.
modelledOn: Monk and Wagner, Concepts in Enterprise Resource Planning
Magal and Word, Integrated Business Processes with ERP Systems
ASCM (APICS), Certified in Planning and Inventory Management (CPIM)
outcomes: Explain what ERP systems do, how integration on a shared database differs from isolated departmental systems, and where their value comes from.
Execute and explain the finance, procurement, inventory, sales and HR processes in an ERP system and the postings each step creates.
Analyse ERP data models, distinguishing organisational structures, master data and transaction data.
Plan inventory and supply using reorder points, economic order quantity and material requirements planning.
Evaluate ERP options and plan an implementation covering selection, fit-gap analysis, data migration, testing and change management.
Recommend an appropriate ERP approach for a small or medium enterprise with limited budget and connectivity.

units.title: What ERP systems do
topics: From isolated departmental systems to integrated enterprise systems; the single source of truth
ERP history: MRP, MRP II, ERP and cloud ERP; the major commercial and open-source products
Modules and how they share data; end-to-end business processes across departments
Benefits, costs and well-known ERP failures

units.title: ERP data models
topics: Organisational structures: company, plant, warehouse, sales and purchasing organisations
Master data: customers, suppliers, materials, chart of accounts, employees; ownership and quality
Transaction data and document flow: orders, deliveries, invoices and payments linked by reference
The relational schema behind an ERP; header and line tables; tracing a document to its tables
Configuration versus customisation; extensions and APIs

units.title: Finance and accounting modules
topics: General ledger, chart of accounts and automatic postings from operational modules
Accounts receivable and accounts payable; subledgers and reconciliation
Asset accounting and depreciation runs; bank reconciliation and mobile money settlements
Controlling: cost centres, profit centres and internal orders
Period-end closing and financial statements; multi-currency transactions in cedis and dollars
Taxes in the ERP: VAT and levies configured for Ghana

units.title: Supply chain and inventory
topics: Procure-to-pay: purchase requisition, purchase order, goods receipt, invoice verification and three-way match
Order-to-cash: quotation, sales order, availability check, delivery, billing and payment
Inventory management: stock types, movements, valuation methods and cycle counting
Inventory planning: reorder points, safety stock, economic order quantity and ABC analysis
Production planning and material requirements planning; bills of materials and routings
A shea butter cooperative's supply chain from collection centres to export

units.title: Human resources and payroll
topics: Organisational management: positions, jobs and reporting lines
Hire-to-retire: recruitment, onboarding, time and attendance, leave and exit
Payroll processing: gross pay, deductions, PAYE and SSNIT contributions, and posting payroll to the ledger
Employee self-service and access to sensitive personal data

units.title: Reporting, integration and controls
topics: Operational reports, embedded analytics and links to a data warehouse
Integration with e-commerce, banks, mobile money and tax authority systems through APIs and files
Authorisations, roles and segregation of duties within the ERP
Audit trails and internal controls built into ERP processes

units.title: Selecting and implementing ERP
topics: Business case and total cost of ownership; on-premise, hosted and SaaS deployment
Vendor selection: requirements, request for proposal, scoring, demonstrations and references
Fit-gap analysis and the choice between changing the process and modifying the software
Implementation approaches: big bang, phased and parallel; implementation methodologies
Data migration, testing, training, cutover and post go-live support
Change management, critical success factors and lessons from failed implementations

units.title: ERP for small and medium enterprises
topics: SME needs and constraints: budget, skills, informal processes and cash-based trading
Open-source and cloud options such as Odoo and ERPNext; accounting packages as a first step
Working with intermittent power and connectivity: offline modes and mobile front ends
Implementing ERP for a pharmacy chain or an agro-processing firm in Ghana

units.title: Trends and capstone
topics: Cloud ERP, two-tier ERP and composable architectures
Analytics, automation and machine learning embedded in ERP
ERP security and data protection obligations
Capstone: configuring and running the full business cycle of a simulated Ghanaian company with an implementation plan

schedule.title: From silos to integrated enterprise systems
schedule.exercise: Describe how an order placed by a customer touches sales, stores, finance and delivery in a company with separate spreadsheets, and what an ERP changes.

tasks.title: Load three separate departmental tables with the same customer entered differently and count the duplicate and conflicting records an integrated system would remove
Trace one customer order through the sales, warehouse and finance modules of a simulated company and record each document created
Review a failed ERP project case, list the five decisions that caused the failure and propose what should have been done instead

schedule.title: Organisation, master data and document flow
schedule.exercise: Draw the organisational structure of a small company in ERP terms, naming its company code, plants, warehouses and sales and purchasing organisations.

tasks.title: Configure the organisational units of a two-plant company in the scenario and check that a sales order resolves to the correct plant
Clean a master data table of 30 customers with duplicates and missing tax numbers, using queries, and report how many records you fixed
Link quotation, order, delivery, invoice and payment tables by document reference and write a query that traces a payment back to its quotation

schedule.title: ERP data model and extension
schedule.exercise: Write a short explanation for a manager of when to change the configuration, when to customise and when to use an API instead.

tasks.title: Create header and line tables for a purchase order, insert three orders and write a query that totals each order by joining them
Given a business document number, write queries that find all related tables and show a complete document chain with item and price details
Decide for six requested changes whether to configure, customise or use an API, and score each against upgrade risk and cost

schedule.title: Financial accounting
schedule.exercise: Post by hand the journal entries for a sale on credit, its receipt in mobile money, and a month of depreciation, and show the ledger balances.

tasks.title: Create a chart of accounts table and write queries that post the automatic ledger entries for 5 sales and purchase transactions and check the trial balance
Reconcile a receivables subledger to the general ledger from given data and find the two entries that cause a difference
Match a month of mobile money settlement records to bank statement lines with queries and list the unmatched items with likely causes

schedule.title: Controlling, period-end and taxes
schedule.exercise: Explain in a paragraph why period-end closing must be completed in a fixed order and what goes wrong if sales are posted after closing.

tasks.title: Allocate shared electricity costs to three cost centres using given drivers in a query and show the resulting cost per centre
Revalue open dollar invoices into cedis at the closing rate, post the exchange differences and produce a simple income statement
Configure VAT and levy rules for a company in Ghana, post six taxed transactions in the scenario and correct the one with a wrong tax code

schedule.title: Procure-to-pay, order-to-cash and inventory
schedule.exercise: Draw a swim-lane flow of procure-to-pay and order-to-cash for a shop, marking where a document is created and which department owns it.

tasks.title: Match a purchase order, goods receipt and supplier invoice for 10 items in a three-way match query and list the lines that fail the tolerance
Run an order-to-cash cycle in the scenario with an availability check, partial delivery, billing and a late payment, and record the documents created
Value stock movements with FIFO and weighted average costing from 20 movements and show how each method changes profit

schedule.title: Inventory planning, MRP and the shea butter supply chain
schedule.exercise: Compute the economic order quantity and reorder point for a fast-moving item from given demand and cost figures, and explain the result.

tasks.title: Classify 40 items by ABC analysis with a query and set a reorder point and safety stock for the A items from demand data
Explode a bill of materials for 100 units of a finished product, net it against stock and list the purchase requirements
Plan the supply chain of a shea butter cooperative from village collection to export, handling a shortage and a late shipment, and score the plan

schedule.title: Human resources and payroll
schedule.exercise: Describe the steps from hiring to exit for one employee and the ERP records and approvals created at each step.

tasks.title: Model positions, jobs and reporting lines in tables and write a recursive query that lists everyone reporting up to a given manager
Compute gross to net pay for 10 employees with PAYE and SSNIT contributions in a query and post the payroll journal
Set access to salary and personal data for HR, managers and employees in the scenario, then handle a request that breaks the rule

schedule.title: Reporting, integration and controls
schedule.exercise: List five integration points a Ghanaian shop's ERP needs with banks, mobile money and tax systems and what data crosses each one.

tasks.title: Write a query that produces an operational sales report by product and month from the ERP tables, and add a total and a percentage column
Build a role and permission table, then query for users who can both create a vendor and approve payments to find segregation conflicts
Examine an audit trail table of 50 changes to find the three suspicious edits, such as backdated or self-approved entries, and report them

schedule.title: Business case, vendor selection and fit-gap
schedule.exercise: Write the cost side of a business case for an ERP over five years, including licences, training, hosting and hidden costs.

tasks.title: Compare on-premise, hosted and SaaS ERP for a mid-size firm with a five year total cost of ownership and choose one in the case
Score three vendor proposals against weighted requirements from a request for proposal and recommend one with reasons
Complete a fit-gap analysis of 15 requirements and decide for each gap whether to change the process or modify the software

schedule.title: Implementation and change management
schedule.exercise: Write a one-page lessons learned note comparing big bang and phased implementation for a company with five branches.

tasks.title: Choose an implementation approach and schedule for a company with limited downtime tolerance and justify the risk trade-offs
Migrate 200 legacy customer rows into the new schema with cleaning rules, reconcile the counts and balances and list the rejected rows
Manage resistance, training and go-live support in a failing implementation case, and select the interventions that rescue the project within budget

schedule.title: ERP for small and medium enterprises
schedule.exercise: Interview a shop owner about their record keeping and list which ERP functions they would actually use in the first year.

tasks.title: Choose the minimum set of ERP modules for a cash-based trader with a small budget in the scenario and defend what you left out
Set up customers, items and stock in a small open-source ERP style schema and record 10 sales to produce a profit report
Plan the ERP implementation for a pharmacy chain in Ghana with expiry tracking, intermittent power and branch stock transfers, and score it

schedule.title: Modern ERP and the capstone
schedule.exercise: Prepare a short briefing for a board on the security and data protection duties that come with moving ERP to the cloud.

tasks.title: Compare cloud ERP and two-tier ERP for a company with a subsidiary abroad and choose the architecture with reasons
Audit a simulated ERP for security and data protection gaps, rank the findings by risk and propose controls
Run the full business cycle of a simulated Ghanaian company, from purchasing to payroll and period-end, and reconcile the final ledger and stock reports
